components.name: Starter Feed (makes 1/2 cup / 100g active starter)
ingredients: 1/3 cup + 1 tbsp (50g) all-purpose flour or bread flour
directions: 12 hours before mixing dough, add ingredients to a clean jar. Stir until combined, loosely cover, and let rise at room temperature until doubled and bubbly.

components.name: Garlic Butter
ingredients: Fresh parsley, finely chopped, for garnishing
directions: Mix the dough: Add all dough ingredients to a large mixing bowl and bring them together with your hands. Turn out onto a clean work surface and knead the dough by hand for about 10 minutes until smooth. (Stand mixer: combine in the bowl of a stand mixer fitted with the dough hook attachment, mix on medium speed for 8–10 minutes.)
Bulk Fermentation: Cover the bowl tightly with plastic wrap and allow the dough to rise 50–70% at room temperature.

Shape: Transfer the dough to a well-floured surface and let it rest for 10 minutes. Divide into 12 equal portions, approximately 80g each. Use your hands to roll each portion out into a log, gently stretch it, and tie it into a knot shape, tucking the ends underneath. Line a large baking sheet with parchment paper and arrange the knots on the sheet, leaving space. Brush each knot with olive oil. Cover with a clean tea towel and let the dough rise until puffy by 30%.
Bake: Preheat oven to 400°F and bake the knots for 20 minutes.
Garlic Butter: Heat the butter, minced garlic cloves, and salt to taste in a small saucepan while the knots are in the oven. Remove the knots from the oven and brush each one with warm garlic butter.
